{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
print('Original shape:', df.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values and sentinel values
print('\nSummary of customer_age:')
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

print('\nSummary of revenue:')
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))

print('\nUnique values in status:')
print(df['status'].value_counts())

print('\nUnique values in channel:')
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

print('\nUnique values in customer_segment:')
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')"}
